title: Miles packages large-scale reinforcement learning for LLMs and VLMs
friendlyTitle: A toolkit for training large AI models with reinforcement learning
summary: Miles is an Apache-2.0 framework for post-training language and vision-language models with reinforcement learning. The roughly 2,500-star project supports several training and rollout backends, agent environments and distributed deployments, and was being actively updated this week.
friendlySummary: Miles brings together the software needed to improve language and vision models using reinforcement learning across many computers.
whyItMatters: Model teams can use Miles to build and scale RL post-training pipelines rather than assembling distributed trainers, rollout engines and evaluation plumbing from scratch. It is infrastructure for experienced model engineers, not a lightweight end-user fine-tuning tool.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Experienced model teams can use it as a starting point for large training systems. It is more complex than tools made for ordinary local fine-tuning.
